book.name: Yohana
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala YOHANA

content: Maryamu soapi Yesumùrú mǝ'rǝmɓoarne
Lang Lamsan Yàlîmurû ueo nongŋo tongno-nong-mwashat ka, Yesu wari a Betani, muna-là mala Liazaro, ɓwa mǝnana wu, sǝ Yesu loasǝi nǝ yilǝmu ka.
À lam girlina mala pwarikpǝra ace pè Yesu gulo. Marta nda gaki girlina ka, sǝ Liazaro ka nda aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana à lì girlina andǝ Yesu ka.
Pǝlǝa Maryamu twal muna-dù mùrú mǝ'rǝmɓoarne, mǝnana à pè nǝ nard mǝɓoarnsari, sǝ kúrè pa bǝti raka, soe arǝ akusǝ Yesu, sǝ hasǝkia nǝ nyang múrí. Kara rǝm mùrú mǝɓoarne man aki ɓala kat.
Sǝ Yahuda Iskariyoti, mwashat atà alaggana mǝnana nǝ̀ nggá mak Yesu ka, na ama,
<<Mana tsǝa sǝ à ginǝ mak man yì mùrú ka a kún dinari gbǝman-tàrú, sǝ boale ka à pè mia amǝ'tǝ̀r ɗàng?>>
Yahuda ka bang anggo, pà acemǝnana kǝ ɓuàce amǝ'tǝ̀r ka ɗàng, nda acemǝnana yì ka, mǝn'í na ka; sǝ acemǝnana yì nda mǝbwal ndaboalo mala alaggana mala Yesu ka, pak ka kǝ iu aɓa boale ace ɓamur rǝì.
Sǝ Yesu na ama,

content.text: <<Wu nying ɓwama man zàng! Gìr mǝnana pe ka nda ace gilǝki luem ace pwari tsǝkban mem.
Wun ngga, wu nda a tarǝ wun wunǝ amǝ'tǝ̀r ko aya pwari ka, sǝ mim ngga ǝn pa atà wun koya pwari ɗàng.>>

content: Kùrkûn amur Liazaro à nǝ̀ wal-luí
Amǝ Yahudi pas ongŋǝna ama Yesu warina a Betani. Pǝlǝa à waria sǝne andǝ Liazaro mǝnana Yesu loasǝi nǝ yilǝmu a ɓembe ka.
Pǝlǝa agbani Pǝris kurkunarǝia, à nǝ̀ wal Liazaro gbal,
acemǝnana nda ace loasǝe nǝ yilǝmu a ɓembe sǝ pas aɓalǝ amǝ Yahudi kǝ ginǝkia, sǝ à kǝ pa ɓamuria a ban Yesu.
Kutio limurǝm mala Yesu aɓa Urǝshalima
Ban fana ka, aɓwana pas mǝnana à yiu ace Lamsan Yàlîmurû ka, à yì ok ama Yesu nda njar aban yiu a Urǝshalima.
Pǝlǝa à twalki ambú nkangga a buia sǝ à puro à nǝ̀ ká kúllì. À kǝ mak-gāwàn, à kǝ na ama,
Yesu kum muna dambǝritso sǝ eauwe do a nzǝmi, kǝla mǝnana Malǝmce na ka ama,

A dǝmbe ka alaggana mala Yesu bwalta amǝnia yì agir ka ama lùmsǝo mala ɓangnǝa na ka ɗàng. Anzǝm mǝnana Ɓakuli loasǝna Yesu nǝ yilǝmu a ɓembe, sǝ Yesu kutina aɓa ɓoarɓwa male ka, nda sǝ ɓalǝia kasǝna arǝ gir mǝnana kumban ngga, sǝ à yì sǝlǝ ama agir mǝnia kat ka, à nda kam à gilǝe amur Kǝrǝsti aɓa Malǝmce.
Ɓwabunda mǝnana à nda atà Yesu a pwari mǝnana tunǝ Liazaro ɓǝ̀ purî ɓembe, sǝ loasǝi nǝ yilǝmu ka, à camarǝ banggia aɓwana cau mala gìr mǝnana à sǝn ngga.
Gìr mǝnana tsǝa sǝ ɓwabundǝa puro waria kúllí Yesu ka, nda acemǝnana à ongŋǝna ama pak mǝnia yì gir'lǝmdǝa ka.
Pǝlǝa amǝ Farisi ne arǝarǝia ama, <<Wu sǝni, túró mǝɓane nda sǝm pakkiyi ka. Ɓanza pwana rǝì kat umna kpate!>>
Yesu nacau amur lú male
Aɓea amǝ Gǝrik nda aɓalǝ aɓwana mǝnana à waria peri a Urǝshalima a Lamsan Yàlîmurû ka.
À yiu a ban Filip, mǝnana yì gbal ka pur a Beseda aɓa Galili ka, sǝ à zǝmba ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, sǝm nggǝ earce sǝn Yesu.>>
Pǝlǝa Filip wario kya banggi Andǝru, sǝ yia kǝm à kutio à kya banggi Yesu.
Yesu nyesǝia wia ama:

content.text: Ado ka pwarî yina, yì mǝnana Ɓakuli nǝ̀ lǝmdǝ gulo mala Muna mala Ɓwa ka.
Mǝ nda ban bangga wun mǝsǝcau, ɓǝ̀ mǝsǝ mǝssa kpa a nzali sǝ wu raka, nǝ̀ ueo anggo nǝmurǝì mwashat. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ wu ka, nǝ̀ pusǝ amǝsǝì pas.
Ɓwa mǝnana kat kǝ earce yilǝmi ka, nǝ̀ ɗwanyibanì, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana ginǝki yilǝmi a man yì ɓanza ka, nǝ̀ kum yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka.

Ɓwa mǝnana kat earce nǝ̀ do a ɓatam ngga, dumǝna púp nǝ̀ yiu atàm, ace mǝnana ban mǝnana kat mǝ nda kam ngga, àkǝ̀ banì sǝ guro mem nǝ̀ pa. Sǝ Tárrám gbal ka nǝ̀ gusǝlǝ ɓwa mǝnana kat pà ɓamúrì kǝ pak túró a ɓatam ngga.

Ado ka ɓabumam kǝ pi, sǝ aman sǝ mǝ nǝ na? Mǝ nǝ na nǝma, <<Dâ, amsǝam aɓa mǝnia yì tanni ka ɓǝ̀ kǝa sulǝ amuram ɗàng>> le? Awo! Mǝnia ka nda tǝr yiu mem, acemǝnana ɓǝ̀n kutio aɓa mǝnia yì bu-pwari mala tanni ka.
We Dâ, yinǝ gulo ace lùllǝò!

content: Kara Ɓakuli nacau nǝ kuli ama, <<Ən angŋa dǝmba ǝn gusǝlǝna lullǝam, sǝ Mǝ nǝ gusǝlǝi ɗǝm.>>
Lang ɓwabundǝa mǝnana à came a banì à ok man yì giu ka, cilia twali ama mgbarangce na. Aɓea ɓwana ka à bang ama, <<Mǝturonjar mala Ɓakuli nda ne wi cau ka!>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama,

content.text: <<Man yì giu ka pà acem sǝ yiu ɗang, nda ace wun.
Pwari mala pakkî mǝnia yì ɓanza ɓashi ka, kārǝ́na; ado sǝ Ɓakuli ak murǝm arǝ Shetan, yì murǝm mala ɓanza man.
Sǝ anzǝm mǝnana à loasǝnam amur nggun-gangndǝi ka, mǝ nǝ nun ɓwapǝndǝa kat a banam.>>

content: Yesu bang anggo acemǝnana ɓǝ̀ lǝmdǝ ulang lú mǝnana nǝ wu ka.
Ɓwabunda pǝlǝa ne Yesu ama, <<Sǝm ok aɓa Nggurcau mala Musa ama, Kǝrǝsti ka nǝ̀ dum nǝ yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka.
Sǝ lang sǝ a na ama, <Dumǝna púp, à nǝ̀ loasǝ Muna mala Ɓwa amur nggun-gangndǝi?> Yana ɓwe nda man yì <Muna mala Ɓwa> ka?>>
Yesu earia wia ama,

content.text: <<Tǎlaban ngga nda a ban wun ado, sǝ banì pà nǝ̀ sau ɗang. Wu gya aɓa mǝnia yì tǎlaban ado mǝnana nda a ban wun ngga, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ pǝndǝa ɓǝ̀ kǝa gìr amur wun ɗàng. Aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ gya aɓa pǝndǝa ka, à kǝ gandǝ sǝn ban mǝnana à káki kam ngga ɗàng.
Wu gūlì arǝ tǎlabanì ado mǝnana nda a ban wun ngga, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu duk amuna mala tǎlaban.>>

content: Anzǝm mana Yesu naná man yì cau ka, pǝlǝa upia wia, à sǝni ɗǝm ɗàng.
Kat andǝ agir-ndǝlǝki mǝnana lǝmdǝ bu Ɓakuli, mǝnana Yesu peǎ a ɓadǝmbia ka, à pà ɓamuria a baní ɗàng.
Mǝnia ka, nda ace lùmsǝ ɓangnǝa mala Ishaya mǝnana bang ama,

content.text: sǝ a ban yan sǝ à

content: Ace mani ka à ginǝ earnǝ Yesu, acemǝnana Ishaya angŋa dǝmba bangŋǝna ama,

content.text: sǝ à pà nǝ̀ nyàre a banam

content: Ishaya bang man yì cau ka, acemǝnana ak dǝmba sǝn gulo mala Yesu ɗiɗyal, sǝ bangcau amurí.
Kat andǝ amani ama pas atà aɓwana-mǝgule mala amǝ Yahudi, pà ɓamuria a ban Yesu ka, à bang ce a ban aɓwana bwāng ɗang, acemǝnana à kǝ ɓanggi amǝ Farisi ɓǝà kǝa pǝria aɓa ndakpapi ɗàng.
Yia ka à kǝ earce ɓwangsǝban mala ɓwapǝndǝa amur ɓwangsǝban mala Ɓakuli.
Cau mala Yesu nǝ̀ ɓashi aɓwana
Pǝlǝa Yesu loasǝ gì kpǝm sǝ na ama:

content.text: Ɓwa mǝnana kat gūlì arǝàm, mǝ nda gūlikiyi arǝàm nǝmurǝam ngga ɗàng, ndaban gūlì gbal arǝ Tárrám mǝnana tasǝam ngga.
Ɓwa mǝnana kat sǝnam ngga sǝna Tárrám mǝnana tasǝam ngga.
Ən yiu kǝla tǎlaban ace pa tǎlaban aɓa pǝndǝa mala ɓanza man, ace mǝnana ɓwa mana kat pà ɓamúrì a banam ngga, ɓǝ̀ kǝa ueo aɓa pǝndǝa ɗang.
Ɓwa mǝnana kat ok kanigir mem, sǝ kpate raka, mǝ nda mǝ nǝ ɓashi wi ka ɗàng. Pa ace ɓashi sǝ ǝn yiu a ɓanza ɗang, ǝn yiu ace amsǝ ɓanza.
Aɓwana mǝnana kat à ginǝam sǝ à ginǝ ak cau mem ngga, à ndanǝ mǝ'ɓashi mǝnana nǝ̀ ɓashia wia ka. Acau mǝnana ǝn nea ka, à nǝ̀ mea a ɓashi a masǝlǝata apwari!
Agir mǝnana kat ǝn nggǝ kània ka, à pà aɓa rǝcandǝa mem ɗàng, Tárrám mǝnana tàsǝàm ngga, nǝ̀ pam nzongcau arǝ mana ɓǝ̀n na sǝ lang sǝ mǝ nǝ né.
Sǝ ǝn sǝlǝna ama anzongcau male ka à nǝ̀ kánǝ ɓwa aɓa yilǝmu mǝnana málá male pà kàm raka. Gìr mǝnana ǝn naki ka nda gìr mǝnana kat Tárrám banggàm mǝ na ka.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Mat 26:6-11; Mar 14:3-9; Luk 7:37-38.
